value.rationale: The sharp coefficient and full deterministic adaptive minimax classification resolve a natural information-theoretic question for a newly introduced energy-function class. The theorem shows that standard dyadic interpolation is asymptotically optimal even against all adaptive nonlinear sampling, and quantifies the compact inclusion. The precisely weighted single-tent extremizer is a structural feature of the full norm, not an arbitrary finite slice.
